title: Ada (All the Sages Whose Father Was Named Ada)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Ada: Shabbat 17a. Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada (Resh Lakish’s children’s teacher): Ketubot 111b. Chama bar Ada (Emissary of Zion in Rav Nachman’s time): Beitzah 25b. Rav Chana bar Ada: Berakhot 62b. Rabbi Yaakov bar Ada: Sanhedrin 66b. Rav Nachman or Nachmani bar Ada: Eruvin 34b and Beitzah 31b. Rav Shimi bar Ada (in Rav Papa’s time): Nazir 50b.

notes.text: This is a collective index of the patronymic bar Ada. The consulted Ketubot 111b calls Chiyya bar Ada Rav; the supplied notice calls him Rabbi. These occurrence-specific forms are retained without a global title change or a claim that the listed sages shared one father.
